desc:
Welcome to Steal a Soccer Card ⚽ UPDATES EVERY WEEKEND!

👍 LIKE THE GAME AND JOIN THE GROUP FOR NEW CARDS!

🕹️ How to Play:
⚽ Buy and upgrade your Soccer Cards
💣 Sneak into other bases and steal their Cards
💰 Earn cash per second from your Cards
🔁 Rebirth to unlock stronger Cards and earn multipliers
🎭 Use gadgets to defend, troll, or outsmart your enemies!

📱 Play on PC, Mobile, or Tablet – grind anytime, anywhere
